clips.title: The story
paras: At Lakeshire, Foreman Oslow struggles to rebuild the Everstill Bridge. Blackrock orcs shattered the crossing, while lost tools and stolen supplies have stalled the work. He needs help recovering his equipment and gathering materials so the town can restore its trade route.

Foreman Oslow works beside the broken Everstill Bridge, trying to reconnect Lakeshire. The span crosses Lake Everstill, linking the western roads toward Elwynn with the eastern shore. Blackrock orcs came down from the crags of Stonewatch and struck the crossing to cripple Lakeshire's trade and military movement. With the bridge broken, the town is split and exposed.

Foreman Oslow has lost the tools and materials needed for repairs. After the bridge fell, replacement tools traveled overland from Goldshire, then went aboard a lake ferry. Blackrock orc catapults struck the vessel, sending Oslow's heavy iron toolbox to the muddy bed of Lake Everstill. Gnolls in Redridge also seized a caravan of new materials from Stormwind, taking the iron pikes and rivets needed to raise the arches.
